title: On Struggling out of the ditch unaided
subtitle: 困难与应对 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 困难与应对（做人与做事·困难与应对）
meta: 主题语境：困难与应对（做人与做事·困难与应对）　|　核心词汇：struggle　|　正文 347 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 struggle 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1981 the operator ① struggled out of the ditch unaided in public, and every trainee in the station said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three shifts on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the operator ② struggles out of the ditch unaided in silence without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ struggle out of the ditch unaided at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ struggled out of the ditch unaided before — a line in the log for June 1975 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Struggling out of the ditch unaided in public, the operator said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the switch at the far screen, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ struggle for ten years to clear the debt in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Struggle for ten years to clear the debt at once and never mention it again.

By 1988 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the log, and a new trainee from the next station ⑧ struggles for ten years to clear the debt in public every shift without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the screen, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ struggled out of the ditch unaided again when nobody else would.

⑩ To struggle out of the ditch unaided, my mother said in 1993, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the station remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the station forgets, somebody struggles out of the ditch unaided in silence again and somebody must struggle out of the ditch unaided in public all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 挣扎（一般过去式 struggled out of the ditch unaided：1981 年操作员头一回这样做，当着众人面）
B. v. 挣扎（一般现在 struggles out of the ditch unaided：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 挣扎（不定式 to struggle out of the ditch unaided：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 挣扎（过去完成时 had struggled out of the ditch unaided：1975 年六月的运行日志上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 挣扎（动名词 struggling out of the ditch unaided 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 奋斗（struggle for ten years to clear the debt：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去奋斗为还清这笔账奋斗了十年）
G. v. 奋斗（struggle for ten years to clear the debt：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 挣扎（后段两处：新来的实习生照例 struggles for ten years to clear the debt，而母亲又一次 struggled out of the ditch unaided）

answers.why: struggle 意为“挣扎”，1981 年操作员当着众人面挣扎独自挣扎着爬出那条沟，那是机房里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 struggled。
struggle 意为“挣扎”，自那以后操作员一言不发地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 struggles。
struggle 意为“挣扎”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯挣扎独自挣扎着爬出那条沟”，此处为不定式 to struggle out of the ditch unaided。
struggle 意为“挣扎”，运行日志里 六月 那行字说明早在 1988 年之前就有人挣扎过，故用过去完成时 had struggled。
struggle 意为“挣扎”，操作员说“挣扎独自挣扎着爬出那条沟这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 struggling out of the ditch unaided 作主语。
struggle 意为“奋斗”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去奋斗为还清这笔账奋斗了十年”，should ever 之后用原形 struggle for ten years to clear the debt。
struggle 意为“奋斗”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻奋斗为还清这笔账奋斗了十年（struggle for ten years to clear the debt at once），以后再也不要提起。
struggle 意为“挣扎”，新来的实习生每个班次都照例奋斗为还清这笔账奋斗了十年，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 struggles。
struggle 意为“挣扎”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次当着众人面挣扎独自挣扎着爬出那条沟，用一般过去式 struggled 叙述。
struggle 意为“挣扎”，结尾那句是母亲 1993 年的话：要挣扎独自挣扎着爬出那条沟，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和机房记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 struggle 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1981 the operator struggled out of the ditch unaided in public, and nobody in the station forgot it.
Even now the operator struggles out of the ditch unaided in silence whenever the station asks.
Struggling out of the ditch unaided in public, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever struggle for ten years to clear the debt in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new trainee from the next station struggles for ten years to clear the debt in public every shift, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother struggled out of the ditch unaided again, and the station remembered that half.
